scripts.postbuild: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const base = '.vercel/output/functions'; if (fs.existsSync(base)) { for (const dir of fs.readdirSync(base)) { const p = base + '/' + dir + '/.vc-config.json'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { const c = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8')); if (c.runtime !== 'nodejs22.x') { c.runtime = 'nodejs22.x'; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(c, null, 2)); console.log('[postbuild] Patched ' + dir + ' runtime to nodejs22.x'); } } } } })"
